title: ci-triage contract data
description: FAFF-391. The SHAPE of `faff ci-triage`'s TriageVerdict — a CI failure classified across three axes (transience/fault_domain/origin) into one derived `action`. `action` is ALWAYS the pure function `deriveTriageAction(transience, fault_domain, origin)` recomputes (never a caller-supplied value trusted as-is): origin `main-was-red` wins outright; any `unknown` routing axis fails closed to `park-needs-human`; `transient` proceeds regardless of fault domain; a `persistent` failure routes on fault domain (`infra` -> park-errored, `code` -> fix-attempt). This schema is NEVER consulted by `faff merge-gate` — the triage verdict is never an input to the merge floor.

main_head_sha.description: String | null — the sha origin was judged against, or null when main's head was unreadable.

main_ci_state.description: String | null — classifyHeadShaChecks' reading of main's head, or null when unreadable.
